correctness.rationale: The weighted orthogonal sum has the stated kernel; the exponential is nonzero and the squared distances satisfy (s−2)^2=2(1−τ). A singleton is optimal for τ>1 and an equilateral triple is optimal at τ=1. For 0≤τ<1 there is a triple at the shorter root. Independent exact enumeration of all 64 edge assignments reproduced the 11 determinant polynomials and verified all six positive-semidefinite rank-two cases via principal minors. The four ratios are 2, (3+√5)/2, 3, 2+√3, with multiplicities 1, 1, 2, 2. The classical planar bound and rigidity give five only for the pentagon; its two squared chords are 2±2/√5 with radius squared 4/5. These checks establish the phase diagram, not just finite numerical evidence. The frozen checker uses exact determinant polynomials but numerical PSD/chord diagnostics; the independent exact replay is in /workspace/branches/4947cce5-3f27-4f7a-851f-09728a477ac6/recompute.py.
